walkthroughs.body_html:
Area A: Everyday Activities — a core area of GCSE German.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Area A: Everyday Activities brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Area A: Everyday Activities.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which sentence correctly says 'I get on well with my mother'?
options: Ich verstehe mich gut mit meiner Mutter.
Ich verstehe mich gut mit meine Mutter.
Ich verstehe mir gut mit meiner Mutter.
Ich verstehen mich gut mit meine Mutter.

mcqs.q: Which form of 'you' do you use addressing a German teacher?
options: Sie
du
ihr
es

mcqs.q: What is the German word for 'Christmas'?
options: Christmas (with English spelling).
Wenachten (omitting the h).
Meiner Schwester.
Weihnachten (singular plural form).

mcqs.q: How do you say 'my sister' in German?
options: Feminine.
Meine Schwester (feminine, nominative).
Meiner Schwester.
Mein Schwester.

mcqs.q: What is the gender of 'Lieblingsfach' (favourite subject)?
options: Masculine (because der Lieblings...).
Feminine.
Neuter (das Fach).
Meiner Schwester.
